meaning:
ἀπό-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποδείκνυμι) [in LXX: 3Ma.4:20, 4Ma.3:19 4Mac 13:10 * ;]
1. a showing off.
2. As used by Gk. philosophers, demonstration, certain proof: 1Co.2:4 (see ICC, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes, 173).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
